speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To narrow this down, have you noticed any rash on your body or a stiff neck recently? Also, have you had close contact with anyone who has been ill?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that detail; please tell me, did you recently consume unpasteurized milk or soft cheeses, or have you been in contact with cats? Additionally, have you noticed any visual changes, such as blurred vision or sensitivity to light?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, CMP, and Infectious Disease Panel (including Listeria, Toxoplasma, and CMV).

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: WBC 15,000/μL (elevated), Hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL, Platelets 200,000/μL; Comprehensive Metabolic Panel: All liver enzymes (AST, ALT, Bilirubin) within normal limits; Infectious Disease Panel: Blood Cultures show Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive with distinctive tumbling motility, consistent with Listeria monocytogenes; Visual examination: No visual changes noted.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.
